text:
maya: Pushed a compact mock that adds a tiny sparkline under the burst pill to show recent scale events. Need quick calls on: guardrail tone, sparkline density (3 vs 7 points), burst label defaults (absolute vs percent), and the pool-picker keyboard trap. figma: https://figma.redwood/infer/autoscale/sparkline-v1

sam: Sparkline is neat for context. My vote: 3 points on mobile, 7 on desktop. Keep it very muted so it doesn't compete with metrics. Also prefer 'Recommended cap' for the guardrail label for self-serve.

nina: Copy + localization notes: shorter is better. Suggested microcopy block (two-line helpers):
```
Min: Always-on GPUs to meet latency targets.
Max: Max scale during spikes (may increase cost).
Guardrail (recommended): Helps keep traffic within SLO; excess may go to fallback capacity.
```
Keep sentences simple for translators.

raj: UX: burst pill: show absolute by default for pools <=6 GPUs (users think in units). For larger pools show percent by default. Also show tiny muted absolute on hover for percent-primary case. On mobile collapse to single-line: prefer percent there.

maya: Agreed on adaptive rule. I'll encode: <=6 absolute primary, 7-20 absolute + muted percent, >20 percent primary. Sam + Raj do we want sparkline to be clickable (open last 24h)?

sam: Clickable would be nice but keep it out of initial scope. Hover with tooltip showing "last 24h peaks" is fine.

a11y-bot: Flag ACC-5012: autoscale-sparkline-contrast & ACC-5013: pool-picker-focus. Sparkline should not be the only conveyance of info (color blind). Provide text alternative on hover and an aria-describedby that summarizes recent bursts.

nina: Important: aria-live when sliders change. Recommend text: "Min set to X GPUs. Max set to Y GPUs. Guardrail recommended at Z GPUs." Keep it short.

raj: On the pool-picker trap: we virtualize and that reflows DOM so Tab gets swallowed. Implement roving tabindex + aria-activedescendant. Escape must close and return focus to the toggle. Also add a tiny hint under the control: "\u2191\u2193 preview \u2022 Enter select \u2022 Esc close". Small, but reduces support tickets.

emg: (typo, meant eng-bot) ENG-BOT: Created ticket INF-3567: implement-roving-tabindex-pool-picker and INF-3568: burst-pill-adaptive-labels. Links: https://tracker.redwood/INF-3567 https://tracker.redwood/INF-3568

sam: Microcopy nit: change 'may go to fallback capacity' to 'may be routed to fallback capacity' 14 - more precise for docs.

nina: For l10n, 'fallback capacity' translates cleanly. Avoid 'throttle' or 'penalize'.

a11y-bot: Also recommend keyboard-visible focus ring for guardrail marker (2px) and ensure sparkline has a non-color indicator (e.g., small dot on peak) so screen readers can get a numeric tooltip: "peak +3 GPUs at 11:02".

maya: OK next steps: I'll update figma with adaptive burst-label rules, add a hover tooltip for sparkline, and darken guardrail marker to meet AA. Raj/Eng: please pick up INF-3567/3568. Nina: can you sanity-check the l10n phrasing once frames are updated?

raj: Will validate keyboard flow once prototype is live. Quick ask: can we emit analytics events: burst_sparkline_hover, burst_label_toggle, pool_picker_hint_shown? Want metrics on which representation users prefer.

sam: Add a tiny AB test: friendly vs strong guardrail phrasing. Measure config completion and help clicks.

maya: Noted. I'll include AB frames. Closing for now; will reopen when updated frames and tickets are linked. Thanks all :sparkles:
